Name: Tap Giant Crops
Author: atravita
Description:
Allows you to tap giant crops.

The tapper should produce the keg output for whatever crop the giant crop corresponds to. Flowers will produce the respective honey, although admittedly [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15055]Wickedy's Floral Essences[/url] make more sense (and will override the honey if installed.)

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932]AtraCore[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods, including giant crops from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5263]More Giant Crops[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365?tab=description]DynamicGameAssets[/url] giant crops are not yet supported.
[*]Doesn't work with Automate yet. Working on that!
[/list]
A note: the tappers are refilled at night, so mods with tooltips (like UI Info Suite) will show them as empty after collection.

[size=5]Other mods in screenshots[/size]

The giant mushroom is from the lovely PurpleChickadee's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12704]Stardrop Bloom[/url]!
